cases.title: Prevent interaction when sub-list is not expanded
cases.description: Verify that if the user attempts to click search or replace items without expanding the sub-list first, no action occurs and the tabs remain hidden.

cases.title: Display Search tab and components correctly
cases.description: Verify that clicking the '查找' list item displays the search tab content including 'search-input' and 'search-button' while hiding the replace tab content.

cases.title: Display Replace tab and components correctly
cases.description: Verify that clicking the '替换' list item displays the replace tab content including 'replace-input-old', 'replace-input-new', and 'replace-button' while hiding the search tab content.

cases.title: Search text successful highlighting and multiple matches
cases.description: Verify that entering valid text into the search input and clicking search highlights all occurrences in the paragraph using a span tag with a yellow background.

cases.title: Search validation for empty input and missing text
cases.description: Verify that searching with an empty input triggers alert '请输入文字！' and searching for non-existent text triggers alert '未找到您要找的文字！'.

cases.title: Replace text successful substitution and exact match handling
cases.description: Verify that entering old and new text replaces all exact matches of the old text with the new text in the paragraph, highlighting them with a yellow span background without affecting substrings incorrectly.

cases.title: Replace validation for empty input and missing text
cases.description: Verify that replacing with an empty old text input triggers alert '请输入文字！' and replacing non-existent old text triggers alert '未找到您要找的文字！'.

analysis.analysis: Testable behaviors include: 1) Toggling sub-list visibility ('lis') via 'expand-list-item' using CSS 'display' ('none'/'block'). 2) Multiple clicks on 'expand-list-item' maintain correct visibility state. 3) Clicking 'search-list-item' displays the 'search' tab with 'search-input' and 'search-button', hiding 'replace' content. 4) Clicking 'replace-list-item' displays the 'replace' tab with 'replace-input-old', 'replace-input-new', and 'replace-button', hiding 'search' content. 5) Attempting to click 'search' or 'replace' without expanding the list first should result in no action/hidden sub-lists. 6) Search functionality: highlights all exact occurrences of entered text in a paragraph using a <span> tag with a yellow background. Empty search input triggers alert '请输入文字！'. Unmatched search text triggers alert '未找到您要找的文字！'. Handles single characters and multiple occurrences. 7) Replace functionality: replaces all case-sensitive occurrences of 'replace-input-old' with 'replace-input-new' in the paragraph, highlighting them with a yellow <span> tag. Exact matches only (substring handling). Empty old text input triggers alert '请输入文字！'. Unmatched old text triggers alert '未找到您要找的文字！'. Dynamic DOM update and original content restoration when switching tabs/dropdowns. Boundaries and abnormal paths include empty inputs, non-existent search/replace strings, substring vs exact word matches, and repeated interactions without page reload.
